column1: Syrona Medical Center HMIS — Reporting Centre
Note: One row per linked diagnosis record, or one row for an encounter without a diagnosis; the total is not a count of patients or cases. Duplicate records are not merged.

Note: Pending means the encounter status is PLANNED, ACTIVE or ON_HOLD; completed and cancelled reflect the recorded encounter status only, not proof of clinical completion or diagnosis confirmation. Other statuses are unknown.

Note: Diagnosis status and coding fields are shown as recorded. Missing or inconsistent patient links withhold diagnosis details; missing code, release or diagnosis status is flagged. No ICD-10 history is recoded or WHO validity inferred.
Note: This operational register is not an MOH 705, statutory morbidity calculation or KHIS submission.
Note: Dates are the recorded database calendar dates; these legacy timestamps do not record a timezone. Review historical timestamp origin before using them as local event dates.
Note: Missing or out-of-scope patient links are not inferred or matched by name and are counted for review.
Note: Data is a live snapshot and may change between pages or when regenerated.
